title: Radiation-induced skeletal muscle injury English review: search-to-revision writing system
rationale: Multi-stage work (search, screening, extraction, drafting, revision) with three distinct failure risks (fabricated references, wrong numbers, overclaimed novelty) that each need an independent verifier anchored to external ground truth, plus iterative draft-revise loops. A linear workflow cannot express independent verification and counter-metric pressure against the drafter; a single loop cannot separate the single-writer resources. Submission stays with Bruce.

root_goal.statement: Produce a submission-ready English narrative/systematic-style review on radiation-induced skeletal muscle injury in which every reference exists and supports its sentence, every number matches its source, and every conclusion is no stronger than its evidence.
root_goal.observable_success: Bruce receives a final manuscript package where (a) 100% of references resolve by DOI/PMID in PubMed/Crossref and match title/authors/year, (b) 100% of numeric claims are traced to a source locator (paper + page/table/figure) and match, (c) 0 open overclaim flags at severity high, (d) PRISMA-style search log is reproducible; Bruce signs off at the final human gate.

allowed_actions: query PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, Embase, Crossref and Google Scholar with the approved search strategy
download or read open-access and Bruce-provided full texts
write and revise internal draft files, evidence tables and verification reports
flag conflicts and escalate to Bruce
forbidden_actions: submit the manuscript to any journal or preprint server
email editors, authors or co-authors on Bruce's behalf
cite any reference not resolved by DOI/PMID/ISBN against an external database
insert any number not traced to a source locator
change approved inclusion/exclusion criteria or research questions without Bruce
paste unpublished or proprietary data into the manuscript
pay article processing charges or any fees

frozen_rules: No reference may enter the draft unless it is in the verified reference library with a resolved DOI/PMID and matching metadata.
Every sentence with a citation must be supported by text in the cited source, recorded as a quote/locator in the evidence table.
Every number (dose, Gy, fraction, %, n, effect size, p, CI, time point, species) must carry a source locator and be checked verbatim against the source.

Claim strength must not exceed evidence level: animal or in vitro findings are not phrased as clinical effects; association is not phrased as causation; 'first', 'novel', 'paradigm' wording requires explicit evidence-based justification and is flagged by default.
Verifiers run in fresh-independent context and never read the drafter's reasoning, only the draft text plus anchors.
Approved protocol (questions, databases, date window, inclusion/exclusion) is frozen after Bruce's gate.
Submission is decided and performed only by Bruce.
failure_policy: On any verifier failure the specific claim/reference/number is returned to drafting with the failure report; after max_iterations without passing, the item is removed from the draft or marked [UNVERIFIED] and escalated to Bruce. Database or full-text access failure pauses the affected node and escalates; never fall back to model memory for references or numbers. Budget exhaustion triggers stop_handoff with the current verified state.

conditions: final package passes all verifiers and is ready for Bruce's review
any loop reaches max_iterations with unresolved high-severity issues
anchor database unreachable or full text unavailable for a load-bearing source
arbitration cannot resolve a drafter-verifier disagreement under the priority policy
any action would require a forbidden action (submission, fees, external email)
stop_handoff.artifact: handoff package: current manuscript, verified reference library (.bib/.ris with DOI/PMID), evidence table with locators, numeric trace sheet, overclaim audit log, PRISMA search log, open-issues list

nodes.responsibility: External ground truth for existence and metadata of every reference.
External ground truth for what each source actually says and reports numerically.
Frozen scope, questions and eligibility criteria.

inputs: Bruce's topic scope and target journal

nodes.responsibility: Bruce approves or edits the protocol; approval freezes it as an anchor.
Run the frozen search strategy in the approved databases; export records with DOI/PMID; deduplicate; log counts for PRISMA.
Title/abstract then full-text screening against frozen criteria with a reason for every exclusion; uncertain items go to Bruce.
Independent re-screen of a random 20% sample plus all uncertain items; report disagreement rate; disagreement >10% sends screening back.

Build the evidence table: per study model (species/cell/human), radiation dose/fractionation, muscle outcomes, mechanisms, key numbers, evidence level, each with verbatim quote and page/table locator.
Write and revise the manuscript sections using only the evidence table and reference library; each citation and number tagged with evidence-table row ID; respond to verifier and auditor reports.

For every reference: resolve DOI/PMID in PubMed/Crossref, match title/authors/year/journal, check retraction; for every cited sentence confirm the source text supports it. Any unresolved reference is a hard fail.

Extract every number/unit/species/time point from the draft and compare against the source span directly (not against the evidence table alone); mismatch, unit error or missing locator is a hard fail.

outputs: numeric trace sheet and mismatch report

nodes.responsibility: Counter-metric to the drafter's coverage/novelty pressure: grade each conclusion's strength against evidence level (in vitro / animal / clinical; association vs causation; n, replication), flag 'first/novel/breakthrough' language, extrapolation across species or dose, and gaps presented as findings.
Resolve disagreements between drafter and verifiers/auditor; decide revise, remove, soften or escalate to Bruce.
nodes.priority_policy: anchor evidence > frozen rules > verifier/auditor findings > drafter preference; unresolved after 2 rounds escalates to Bruce

inputs: numeric trace sheet and mismatch report

nodes.responsibility: Track iterations, budget, verifier pass rates and frozen-rule compliance; detect verifier rubber-stamping (passing without anchor checks) and score drift; trigger stop_handoff.
